verdict.rationale: The pack publishes this card's memory bandwidth (640 GB/s GDDR6 on a 256-bit bus) and lists llama.cpp/vLLM support for Radeon 9000 GPUs. However, it never states the RX 9070 XT's own VRAM capacity and offers no evidence that a 70B-class quantized model fits or runs practically on it. The 'up to 48GB of VRAM' line describes Radeon GPUs generally rather than this card, so it cannot be credited here.
